concerns.text: T008's verification demands exactly 12 rows (3 transformations × 2 tests × 2 metrics) conforming to aggregated_result.schema.yaml, but that schema has no effect_size field and additionalProperties:false. T010's power_curves.png requires 'power vs. effect size per transformation/test', which cannot be derived from aggregated_results.csv as specified. T010 must instead read the per-effect JSONs from T007, or the schema must be extended — as written, T010 is not executable from its named inputs.

T005/T006/T007 introduce an untransformed 'baseline' condition (T006 verification: '≥ 4 × 2 × N_processed rows'; T005's pass criterion depends on baseline error), but the transformation and aggregated_result schema enums contain only box_cox/yeo_johnson/rank_based. Baseline rows cannot be written to any contract-conformant output, and T008's 12-row count excludes baseline, contradicting T006's 4-condition output. Specify where baseline results live and how T008 handles them.

Plan T021 mandates 5000 label-shuffle replicates per dataset; T006 specifies 1000 (pilot T005 uses 2000). An implementer cannot determine the required iteration count; pick one and reconcile the compute-budget claim.
Bootstrap resample count disagrees: plan says 10,000, T008 says '≥ 2000'. The count affects whether SC-004's ±0.02 half-width is attainable; fix a single number.

'4 effect/baseline × 3 transformations × 2 tests of expected JSON files exist' is ambiguous: is it 4×3×2=24 files (baseline also transformed?) or 3 effect sizes × (3 transformations + baseline) × 2 tests = 24 with a different layout? The JSON filename pattern 'results/power/<effect>_<trans>_<test>.json' has no slot for baseline. Specify the exact expected file count and naming for baseline runs.

T009 writes 'results/aggregated/sensitivity_analysis.json' while the plan and T008/T010 reference 'results/sensitivity_results.csv' / sensitivity_analysis.json at results/ top level; also plan places scripts under code/data/ and code/analysis/ while tasks use code/ top level (code/download_datasets.py, code/analyze_type1_error.py). Align paths so T001's main.py orchestration and T012's integration test resolve the right modules.

T005's validation pass criterion (baseline untransformed error in [0.04, 0.06]) may legitimately fail on a non-normal real dataset, yet the task gives no instruction for what to do on failure (choose another dataset? record fail and proceed?). Without a failure branch the task is not deterministically executable.
